title: Coffee Table Round 01

title: Hotel check-in pod · original Blender model
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Standalone open check-in pod (Holiday Inn Express Formula Blue style), 1.5 m: white solid-surface shell with rounded corners, navy inlay band, cobalt LED under the toe kick and the top overhang (material "led_blue"). Staff side: monitor, keycard encoder, receipt printer; guest side: card terminal. Original CC0, built by script in Blender 4.0 (projects/roadside-inn/blender/lobby.py). Meters, Y up, origin at floor center, front faces +Z. Poly Haven oak/cotton maps (CC0).
